mapper.select:
select t1.* from TBL_CEA_IP_MANAGE t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t2.STAFFID = t1.APPLYPEOPLE left join TBL_ORGANIZATION t3 on t3.ORGID = t1.APPLYBELONGGROUP where 1=1 and (t1.creator = #{param.creator}
or t1.creator in (SELECT DISTINCT STAFFID FROM TBL_USER_ORGRELATION WHERE DEPTID IN (${param.getDeptIds})) )
and t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.applyPeopleName},'%'))
and t3.ORGNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.applyBelongGroupName},'%'))
order by t1.id desc
